question.text:
While sorting the numbers $\text{(70, 48, 76, 58, 43, 47, 78, 53)}$ using quicksort, the last number is chosen as pivot, what will be the permutation of the numbers after partition function has been applied?

  1. $\text{48 43 47 53 70 76 78 58}$
     
  2. $\text{43 47 48 53 58 70 76 78}$
     
  3. $\text{48 47 43 53 70 78 76 58}$
     
  4. $\text{47 48 43 53 78 76 70 58}$
question.subject: Algorithms
